applies_why: The judge text addresses whether the cited verse Luke 2:48-49 counts as an unanswered witness in D4 vs C2, which is the subject of K-G4.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge expressly says the verse was answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness, so the text obeys K-G4.
